description: Inputs for generating renderer-ready avatar action clips for MassGen mission families.

keypoint_convention.notes: Keypoints are optional. Text-only actions should set keypoints to null.

human_adult_blue_jacket.appearance_prompt: adult wearing a blue jacket and dark pants

human_adult_green_sweater.appearance_prompt: adult wearing a green sweater and light trousers

human_elderly_gray_coat.appearance_prompt: elderly person wearing a gray coat

human_student_red_hoodie.appearance_prompt: young adult student wearing a red hoodie and backpack

stand.instruction: Stand in place with a neutral relaxed posture. Keep feet planted, allow small natural breathing and posture shifts, and face forward.
quality_checks: first and last frames loop smoothly

busy_idle.instruction: Stand in place as a busy bystander who is not engaging the robot. Add subtle weight shifts and small head or hand movement, but do not wave or step away.

walk.instruction: Walk forward at a normal indoor pace with natural arm swing. Keep the motion loopable for path-following retiming.
quality_checks: root motion can be replaced by map path

walk_slow.instruction: Walk forward slowly and carefully with a shorter stride. Keep the motion loopable for path-following retiming.
quality_checks: slow pace is visually distinct from normal walk
root motion can be replaced by map path

walk_fast.instruction: Walk forward briskly at a fast indoor pace without running. Keep the motion loopable for path-following retiming.
quality_checks: fast pace is visually distinct from normal walk
root motion can be replaced by map path

queue_wait.instruction: Stand in a queue facing forward. Keep feet nearly planted, make small patient waiting movements, and occasionally shift weight without leaving the queue position.

receive_item.instruction: Stand near a service robot, extend both hands slightly forward to receive a small item, bring it toward the torso, then settle back to neutral standing.
quality_checks: non-looping clip ends in neutral stance

wave.instruction: Stand in place and wave one hand at a nearby robot to get attention. Keep the gesture friendly and readable from a first-person robot camera.
quality_checks: right hand clearly rises above shoulder

point_guidance.instruction: Stand in place, acknowledge the robot, then point clearly toward the destination direction as if giving route guidance.
quality_checks: non-looping clip returns to stable stance

yield_stop.instruction: Pause and yield space to a nearby robot or pedestrian. Make a small side-step or lean, then hold a stopped posture.
quality_checks: yield posture is distinct from normal idle

turn_left.instruction: Pivot in place to the left by 90 degrees while keeping feet near the same spot and ending balanced.

turn_right.instruction: Pivot in place to the right by 90 degrees while keeping feet near the same spot and ending balanced.
